## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* is a text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka of the Pali Canon. As the first triad-combination chapter, it synthesizes the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) with the feeling triad (*vedanāttika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. Its opening exposition in the chapter on conditionality or dependence (*paṭiccavāra*) analyzes conditional relations, such as how, dependent on a wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, there may arise a wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, conditioned by way of root (*hetupaccaya*) [Nyanatiloka 2007].
